y-m-58-05.title: Jimillar lambobin zar: kwatanta samfura biyu
y-m-58-05.topic: Asalin ƙidaya da yiwuwar faruwa: kwatanta samfura biyu
y-m-58-05.goal: Nemo bambancin samfura biyu da ke bayyana abu ɗaya, gwada su da bayanan kwaikwayo, sannan ka bayyana kuskuren zato cewa “yawan sakamakon da zai yiwu yana nufin dukansu suna da damar faruwa iri ɗaya.”
y-m-58-05.material: Kana son gano jimillar lambobin biyu idan aka jefa zar masu adalci biyu lokaci guda; jimillar za ta kasance daga 2 zuwa 12. Ɗalibai biyu sun bayyana ta hanyoyi daban. Minjun: “Jimillar na iya zama 2, 3, …, 12, wato yiwuwar 11, saboda haka kowace tana da damar faruwa iri ɗaya.” Seoa: “Ya kamata mu bambanta zar biyu, mu ɗauki dukkan nau’ikan jeri 36 (lamba ta farko, lamba ta biyu) a matsayin masu damar faruwa iri ɗaya, sannan mu ƙidaya nau’ikan da ke ba da kowace jimilla.”
y-m-58-05.thinking.0: Kwatanta ƙimomin da samfuran biyu suka hasashe
y-m-58-05.thinking.2: Gyara kuma sake rubuta kuskuren fahimta

y-m-58-05.prereq.1: Kimantawa ta amfani da rabo da ƙimar da ake sa ran samu (jimillar yawan gwaji × rabo)
y-m-58-05.s.s1.prompt: Kafin duba sakamakon gwaji, wane hukunci ne ya fi dacewa game da bayanan nan biyu?
y-m-58-05.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta dukkan nau’ikan jeri masu jimillar 2 da dukkan masu jimillar 7.

y-m-58-05.s.s1.o.a: Bayanin Minjun daidai ne. Akwai sakamako 11 na jimilla kawai, saboda haka dukansu suna da damar faruwa iri ɗaya
y-m-58-05.s.s1.r.a: Ka ƙidaya yawan sakamakon ne kawai, ba ka yi la’akari da sau nawa kowanne sakamako ke faruwa ba.
y-m-58-05.s.s1.o.b: Bayanan biyu suna hasashen ƙima ɗaya ga kowace jimilla, saboda haka babu buƙatar kwatanta su
y-m-58-05.s.s1.r.b: Wataƙila ba ka ƙididdige ƙimomin da bayanan biyu suka hasashe ga kowace jimilla da gaske ba.
y-m-58-05.s.s1.o.c: Bayanin Seoa ya fi gamsarwa, domin yawan yanayin da ke samar da kowace jimilla ya bambanta
y-m-58-05.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci yana nazarin yawan nau’ikan jeri da ke samar da kowace jimilla.
y-m-58-05.s.s1.o.d: Ba za mu iya sanin wanda yake daidai ba sai mun yi gwaji
y-m-58-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne mai kyau da ya bambanta nazarin tsari da gwaji, sannan ya zaɓi hanyar dubawa.
y-m-58-05.s.s1.explain: Jimillar 2 tana da yanayi ɗaya kawai, (1,1), amma jimillar 7 tana da shida: (1,6),(2,5),(3,4),(4,3),(5,2),(6,1). Minjun ya ɗauki “menene jimillar” a matsayin abin ƙidaya, ya ce damar dukansu iri ɗaya ce, amma waɗannan abubuwa ba su da damar iri ɗaya.
y-m-58-05.s.s1.acc.0: Sha’awar tabbatarwa ta gwaji ra’ayi ne mai kyau. Amma da farko za ka iya nazarin bambancin bayanan biyu daga tsarinsu kawai: yawan yanayin da ke samar da kowace jimilla ya bambanta.
y-m-58-05.s.s2.prompt: Waɗannan sakamako ne na ƙirƙira daga kwamfuta da ta kwaikwayi wannan yanayi sau 600. Jimillar 7 ta bayyana sau 101, jimillar 2 kuma sau 15. Yaya za ka fassara wannan sakamako?

y-m-58-05.s.s2.explain: Bisa bayanin Minjun, idan aka jefa zar sau 600, jimillar 7 za ta bayyana kusan sau 55, kuma karkacewar sa’a yawanci tana cikin ±14 (sau biyu na karkacewar mizani kusan 7). 101 ya yi nisa sosai, don haka yana da wuya a ce sa’a ce kawai. Ya kusan yi daidai da 100 da Seoa ya sa ran samu.
y-m-58-05.s.s3.prompt: A cikin jimloli ɗaya ko biyu, rubuta ra’ayin da bai dace ba a bayanin Minjun, sannan ka lissafta ka rubuta kusan sau nawa jimillar 6 za ta bayyana cikin gwaji 600 bisa bayanin Seoa.

y-m-58-06.goal: Yi amfani da misali mai karo da ƙa’ida don nuna cewa ka’idar “idan kusurwoyi iri ɗaya ne, siffofin suna kama” tana aiki ga alwatika amma ba ga siffofi masu kusurwa huɗu ba, sannan ka bayyana dalilin bambancin.
y-m-58-06.material: Doyun ya taƙaita da cewa “siffofi biyu masu daidaitattun dukkan kusurwoyin da suka dace siffofi ne masu kama.” Malami ya ce a bincika ko wannan da’awar gaskiya ce ga dukkan siffofi.

y-m-58-06.s.s1.prompt: Wanne daga cikin waɗannan yake aiki koyaushe?

y-m-58-06.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi amfani da “idan kusurwoyi daidai ne, siffofin suna kama,” wadda take aiki ga alwatika, kai tsaye ga siffofi masu kusurwa huɗu.

Shigar da nau’i 2 na siffofi daban-daban.
y-m-58-06.s.s2.hint.0: Dukkan kusurwoyi huɗu na murabba’in murabba’i mai kusurwa huɗu kusurwoyin dama ne koyaushe, don haka an riga an cika sharadin kusurwoyi. Abin da ya rage shi ne zaɓen tsawon ɓangarori.

y-m-58-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Rubuta abin da ba ya canzawa da abin da ke canzawa idan ka ƙara faɗin murabba’in murabba’i mai kusurwa huɗu.
y-m-58-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Gwada ko za ka iya canza rabon ɓangarorin alwatika bayan an ƙayyade dukkan kusurwoyinsa.
y-m-58-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Shin bayaninka ya ƙunshi “ko an ƙayyade rabon ɓangarori bayan an ƙayyade kusurwoyi”?

y-m-58-10.title: Lokacin karatu da maki: yaya nisa za mu iya tafiya da abin da muke faɗa?
y-m-58-10.topic: Haɗin bayanai: bambance dangantaka da sanadi
y-m-58-10.goal: Ka fahimci cewa ganin dangantaka (yanayi) tsakanin masu canji biyu bai ba ka damar da’awar sanadi ba, ka daidaita ƙarfin tabbacin ka idan an ƙara bayanai, sannan ka ba da shawarar tsarin binciken da zai gwada sanadin.
y-m-58-10.material: An yi wa ɗaliban aji tambayoyi game da sa’o’in da suka yi karatu a makon kafin jarabawa da makinsu (bayanan ƙirƙira). Ana bayyana bayanan a mataki-mataki. Da’awa: “Idan ka ƙara lokacin karatu, makinka zai tashi.”
y-m-58-10.thinking.0: Bambance abin da za a iya faɗa daga bayanai da wanda ba za a iya faɗa ba
y-m-58-10.thinking.1: Daidaita ƙarfin tabbaci da sabon bayani
y-m-58-10.prereq.0: Ma’anar haɗin kai mai kyau da mara kyau a jadawalin warwatse
y-m-58-10.prereq.1: Karanta dangantakar masu canji biyu daga tebur
y-m-58-10.s.s1.prompt: Rubuta hukuncinka yayin da ake bayyana bayanai.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.hint.0: Ka rubuta dabam ko bayanan da aka tabbatar a wannan mataki suna nuna “canzawa tare” ko shaida cewa “ɗaya yana canza ɗayan.”
y-m-58-10.s.s1.hint.1: Nuna ko sabon bayani yana ƙarfafa da’awar, yana raunana ta, ko yana ba da damar wani bayani.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.0.info: (M lokacin karatu, maki) na ɗalibai 6: (1, 45), (2, 50), (3, 58), (4, 62), (5, 70), (6, 75). Makin sun kusan kwance a kan layi madaidaici (ƙididdigar haɗin kai kusan 0.997).
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me za a iya faɗa daga wannan bayanin?
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Makin 6 kusan suna kan layi, don haka bayanan suna goyon bayan magana “yanayin a bayyane yake.” Amma kalmar “yana ƙara,” wadda ke da’awar sanadi, bayanan kaɗai ba su tabbatar da ita ba tukuna.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: A cikin waɗannan ɗalibai 6, waɗanda suka fi yin karatu a bayyane suna da halin samun maki mafi girma
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan hukunci ya bayyana yanayin da aka gani dabam da sanadin.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Za mu iya tabbata cewa lokacin karatu yana ƙara maki
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka ɗauki canzawa tare a matsayin sanadi.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Masu canjin biyu ba su da dangantaka
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Ba ka lura da yanayin bayyane ba, ko ka yi watsi da shi.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Bayan ƙarin bincike, a cikin waɗannan ɗalibai 6, ɗaliban 3 da suka fi ƙwarewa a gwajin tantancewa na baya su ne waɗanda suka yi karatu na sa’o’i 4, 5 da 6.

y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Har yanzu an tabbatar, domin haɗin kai yana da girman 0.997 sosai
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka ɗauki girman haɗin kai a matsayin shaida ta sanadi.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Wataƙila wani abu, wato ƙwarewar farko, ne ya jawo hakan, saboda haka yana da wuya a da’awar sanadi
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ka yi la’akari da wani abu da zai iya shafar sakamakon.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Ƙwarewa ce ta jawo shi, saboda haka lokacin karatu ba ya da wani tasiri ga maki ko kaɗan
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ka yi tsalle daga ganin wani abu dabam zuwa akasin ƙarshe.

y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Yanayin har yanzu yana nuni zuwa sama da dama, amma ya fi na farko rauni sosai
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka sake kimanta ƙarfin yanayin tare da sabon bayanin.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Waɗannan ɗalibai biyu da aka ƙara baƙin ɗalibai ne, a yi watsi da su
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ka cire bayanan da ba su dace da ra’ayinka ba ba tare da dalili ba.
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Yanayin ya ɓace, kuma a zahiri yayin da lokaci ya ƙaru maki yana raguwa
y-m-58-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ka yi da’awar akasin yanayi daga maki biyu kawai.

y-m-58-10.s.s2.prompt: A cikin jimloli biyu ko uku, rubuta yadda za ka tsara bincike don tantance ko “ƙara lokacin karatu yana ƙara maki” sanadi ne.

y-m-58-10.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin hanyar kwatanta ɗalibai masu kusan ƙwarewar farko iri ɗaya, amma lokacin karatunsu ya bambanta kawai.

y-m-58-10.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka kuma yi tunani kan matsalolin rayuwa ta ainihi ko batutuwan ɗabi’a?
y-m-58-10.s.s2.model.0: Raba ɗalibai masu irin ƙwarewa zuwa ƙungiyoyi biyu ta hanyar kuri’a; ka sa ƙungiya ɗaya ta yi karatu na ƙayyadadden lokaci kowace rana, ɗayar kuma ta yi karatu kamar yadda ta saba, sannan ka kwatanta maki. Rarrabawa bisa sa’a yana gauraya ƙwarewar farko daidai a ƙungiyoyin biyu.
y-m-58-10.s.s2.model.1: Haɗa ɗalibai masu kusan maki iri ɗaya a gwajin tantancewa na baya-bayan nan, ka sa ɗaya daga kowace ma’aurata ya ƙara lokacin karatu, ɗayan kuma ya yi kamar yadda ya saba, sannan ka kwatanta bambancin makinsu.

y-m-58-08.title: Idan akwai maƙura amma ba ita ce mafi ƙaranci ba
y-m-58-08.topic: Asalin amfani da ayyukan murabba’i: mafi ƙaranci a iyakataccen zangon
y-m-58-08.goal: Ka fahimci cewa idan yankin aiki yana da iyaka, ana iya ƙayyade mafi ƙarancin aiki a ƙarshen tazara maimakon a maƙura; nemo ka gyara kuskuren, sannan ka nemo tazarorin da suka cika sharadi da kanka.
y-m-58-08.material: Ka yi la’akari da aikin f(x)=(x−2)². Jadawalinsa yana da maƙura a (2, 0) kuma yana buɗewa zuwa sama (idan x ya ƙara nisa daga 2, f(x) yana ƙaruwa). Idan yankin aiki bai ƙunshi dukkan lambobin gaske ba, sai dai tazara rufaffiya [a, b], muna nemo mafi girma da mafi ƙaranci na f.

y-m-58-08.s.s1.prompt: Wannan mafita ce ga yankin aiki 3 ≤ x ≤ 5. Zaɓi layin da bai dace ba.

y-m-58-08.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi duk tazarorin da mafi ƙarancin f yake 0 idan yankin aiki shi ne wannan tazara.

y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.b: Wannan zaɓi ya san cewa iyakar tazara ma tana cikin yankin aiki.

y-m-58-08.s.s2.r.d: Wannan zaɓi ya bincika yanayin da maƙura take cikin tazara.

y-m-58-01.material: A aji an bayyana aiki haka: “Idan kowane kashi x na saiti X ya haɗu da daidai kashi guda na saiti Y, ana kiran haɗin aikin daga X zuwa Y.” Yau X={1,2,3,4}, Y={0,1,2,3}. Akwai haɗi huɗu (가) zuwa (라). [lambobi: 1, 2, 3, 4, 0, 1, 2, 3]

y-m-58-07.title: Bayanan iri ɗaya, jadawali mai nuna ra’ayi daban
y-m-58-07.topic: Nuna bayanai: bayanai iri ɗaya, jadawali daban-daban
y-m-58-07.goal: Ka fahimci yadda ƙimar farawa da zangon ginshiƙin tsaye suke sa bayanai iri ɗaya su bayyana daban, ka gano kuma ka gyara fassarar da ta wuce gona da iri, sannan ka zaɓi ma’aunin da ya dace da sharadi da kanka.
y-m-58-07.material: Adadin kayayyakin da shago ya sayar kowane wata (ƙirƙirarren bayani) shi ne 200 a Janairu, 204 a Fabrairu, 208 a Maris, da 212 a Afrilu. Jaridar A ta buga jadawalin layi mai ginshiƙin tsaye daga 0 zuwa 250; jaridar B kuma ta buga jadawali daga 198 zuwa 214. Maki a jadawalin biyun bayanai iri ɗaya ne. Layin jadawali B yana kama da yana tashi da sauri.
y-m-58-07.thinking.1: Nemo kuskuren da’awa mai wuce gona da iri
y-m-58-07.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri ginshiƙi da ya dace da sharadi
y-m-58-07.prereq.0: Karanta jadawalin layi (matakin makarantar sakandare ta farko)
y-m-58-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk maganganun da suke gaskiya game da jadawalin biyun.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.hint.0: Karanta ƙimar maki na Janairu da na Afrilu a kowane jadawali biyu, sannan ka kwatanta su.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunani kan yadda bambancin zangon ginshiƙan tsaye yake shafar gangaren layi.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.a: Jadawali B ya fi gangara, saboda haka ainihin sayarwa ta ƙaru da sauri a B
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka fassara siffar jadawalin a matsayin bambanci a bayanai.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.b: Canza wurin farawa da tazarar ma’aunin ginshiƙin tsaye na iya ba da ra’ayi daban ko da bayanai iri ɗaya ne
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.b: Ka san cewa yadda ake nuna bayanai na iya canza ra’ayi, ko da bayanai iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.c: Jadawali B, wanda ginshiƙinsa na tsaye bai fara daga 0 ba, jadawali na ƙarya ne da ya nuna ƙimar bayanai daban
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.c: Makin B ma suna nuna ƙimomi iri ɗaya da ainihin bayanai. Matsalar ba ƙimomin ba ce, ra’ayin da ma’auni ya ƙirƙira ne.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.o.d: Adadin sayarwar da maki a jadawalin biyun suke nunawa daidai yake
y-m-58-07.s.s1.r.d: Wannan zaɓi yana tabbatar da cewa an zana bayanai iri ɗaya da ma’auni daban-daban.
y-m-58-07.s.s1.explain: Jadawalin biyun suna nuna bayanai iri ɗaya ne kawai da ginshiƙan tsaye daban. Canza ginshiƙi na iya sa layin ya fi gangara, amma ainihin sayarwa iri ɗaya ce. Haka kuma ginshiƙin da ya fara daga 0 ba koyaushe ne ya fi kyau ba (misali, idan ana son nuna ƙananan canje-canje).
y-m-58-07.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi layin da ba daidai ba a bayanin ɗan jarida B game da labarin.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.hint.0: Karanta ƙimar da ta yi daidai da tsayin 0 a jadawali B.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka nemo da kanka rabon sayarwa na Janairu da Afrilu.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.0: Sayarwa ta ƙaru da kayayyaki 4 kowane wata: 200, 204, 208, 212.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.1: Daga Janairu zuwa Afrilu ya ƙaru da 12, saboda haka ya ƙaru da kaso 6 bisa ɗari na ƙimar farko.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.2: A jadawali B, maki na Afrilu yana da tsayi sau 7 na maki Janairu, saboda haka sayarwa ta ninka sau 7.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.line.3: Saboda haka za a iya rubuta cewa wannan shago yana bunƙasa da sauri sosai.
y-m-58-07.s.s2.explain: Layi na 3 ne kuskuren. Ginshiƙin tsaye na jadawali B yana farawa daga 198, don haka tsayin maki yana nuna bambanci daga 198 kawai (2 da 14). Ainihin sayarwa ta ƙaru daga 200 zuwa 212, wato kaso 6 bisa ɗari ne, ba ninki 7 ba. Layi na 4 ƙarshe ne da ya dogara da wannan kuskure.
y-m-58-07.s.s3.prompt: Yanzu kana son zana jadawalin labari C da gaskiya. Zaɓi ƙasan y0 da saman y1 na ginshiƙin tsaye (dukkansu ninkin 10 ne, y0 bai wuce 200 ba, y1 kuma bai gaza 212 ba) domin ƙarin 12 daga Janairu zuwa Afrilu ya zama kaso 10 ko ƙasa da haka na tsawon ginshiƙin gaba ɗaya. Domin ma’aunin kada ya yi faɗi da yawa, y1−y0 bai wuce 400 ba. Shigar da nau’i 2 daban na (y0, y1).
